title: The C++ Standard Library
description: What ships in std, how the headers are organised, and how the standard library differs from the language itself.

descriptionI18n.zh-Hant: std 裡有甚麼、標頭檔如何組織，以及標準程式庫與語言本身的分別。

questions.prompt: Which namespace contains the standard library?

prompt.zh-Hant: 標準程式庫放在哪一個命名空間？

explanation.zh-Hant: 幾乎所有標準程式庫名稱都在 std；<cstdlib> 只是其中一個標頭檔。

questions.explanation: Almost every standard library name lives in std. <cstdlib> is just one of its headers.

questions.prompt: Which part of the standard library provides std::sort?

prompt.zh-Hant: 標準程式庫的哪一部分提供 std::sort？

explanation.zh-Hant: sort 是 <algorithm> 中的演算法；容器只負責儲存元素。

questions.explanation: sort is an algorithm declared in <algorithm>; containers only store elements.

questions.prompt: The C++ standard library is specified by the C++ standard, not by an individual compiler vendor.

prompt.zh-Hant: C++ 標準程式庫由 C++ 標準規定，而不是由個別編譯器廠商決定。

explanation.zh-Hant: ISO C++ 標準定義程式庫的行為；各家實作（libstdc++、libc++、MSVC STL）遵循同一份規格。

questions.explanation: The ISO C++ standard specifies the library's behaviour. Implementations such as libstdc++, libc++ and MSVC STL all follow that specification.

questions.prompt: libstdc++ and libc++ are two implementations of the C++ standard library.

prompt.zh-Hant: libstdc++ 與 libc++ 是 C++ 標準程式庫的兩種實作。

explanation.zh-Hant: libstdc++ 隨 GCC，libc++ 隨 Clang/LLVM；兩者都實作同一份標準介面。

questions.explanation: libstdc++ ships with GCC and libc++ with Clang/LLVM. Both implement the same standard interface.

questions.prompt: Which of these are standard library headers? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列哪些是標準程式庫標頭檔？可多選。

explanation.zh-Hant: <memory>、<thread>、<regex> 都是標準標頭；<windows.h> 是 Windows 平台 API。

questions.explanation: <memory>, <thread> and <regex> are standard headers. <windows.h> is a platform API, not part of std.

questions.prompt: Which of these belong to the C++ standard library? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列哪些屬於 C++ 標準程式庫？可多選。

d.zh-Hant: 圖形使用者介面工具包

explanation.zh-Hant: 容器、演算法、串流與字串都是標準程式庫的一部分；GUI 工具包（如 Qt）不是。

questions.explanation: Containers, algorithms, streams and strings are all part of the standard library. GUI toolkits such as Qt are third-party libraries.

questions.prompt: The standard library implementation shipped with GCC is called lib____.

prompt.zh-Hant: 隨 GCC 發佈的標準程式庫實作稱為 lib____。

explanation.zh-Hant: GCC 使用 libstdc++；Clang 預設常用 libc++。

questions.explanation: GCC ships libstdc++; Clang commonly uses libc++.

questions.prompt: The standard library implementation shipped with Clang/LLVM is lib____.

prompt.zh-Hant: 隨 Clang/LLVM 發佈的標準程式庫實作是 lib____。

explanation.zh-Hant: Clang 通常配 libc++，GCC 則配 libstdc++；兩者都實作同一份標準介面。

questions.explanation: Clang commonly uses libc++; GCC ships libstdc++. Both implement the same standard interface.

prompt.zh-Hant: 為何正式專案應避免使用 `<bits/stdc++.h>`？

model.zh-Hant: 它不是標準標頭，只有部分編譯器提供，移植到其他編譯器會失敗；而且它一次引入大量標頭，令編譯變慢、相依關係不明。

explanation.zh-Hant: 可移植性與編譯時間是兩大理由；應只包含實際用到的標準標頭。

answer.model: It is not a standard header and is only provided by some compilers, so the code fails to build elsewhere. It also pulls in a large number of headers at once, which slows compilation and hides real dependencies.

questions.explanation: Portability and build time are the two main reasons. Include only the standard headers you actually use.

questions.prompt: Which C++ version added the <numbers> header?

prompt.zh-Hant: 哪一個 C++ 版本加入了 <numbers> 標頭檔？

explanation.zh-Hant: <numbers> 在 C++20 引入，提供 std::numbers::pi 等數學常數。

questions.explanation: <numbers> arrived in C++20 and provides mathematical constants such as std::numbers::pi.
